title: HackHero AI
summary: Intelligent Cybersecurity CTF Assistant & Vulnerability Analysis Toolkit.
description: HackHero AI is an interactive cybersecurity helper and analysis framework designed to aid security students and researchers in breaking down Capture The Flag (CTF) challenges, analyzing payload structures, reverse engineering logic, and applying cybersecurity best practices.
highlights: Assists in dissecting web exploitation, cryptography, and forensics challenges
Automates payload pattern recognition and hash classification
Provides step-by-step security remediation guides for common vulnerabilities
keyFeatures: CTF Challenge Category Resolver (Web, Crypto, Reverse, Forensics)
Automated Hash & Encoding Decoder (Base64, Hex, ROT13, SHA-256)
Vulnerability Remediation Engine with OWASP Top 10 mappings
Interactive command-line & clean web visualization mode
architectureDetails: Built using Python and TypeScript modular rules. Executes static analysis routines on challenge inputs, parses file headers, and presents structured security insights.

title: SOC Shield AI
summary: Security Operations Center Log Analysis & Threat Detection Engine.
description: SOC Shield AI is a lightweight Security Operations Center dashboard and log analysis utility that parses syslog, auth.log, and network event streams to identify brute-force attempts, unauthorized access, port scans, and suspicious IP behaviors.
highlights: Real-time event parsing for authentication logs and firewall telemetry
Rule-based alerting for brute-force SSH attacks and port scanning
Interactive SOC metric visualization with severity scoring
keyFeatures: Rule Engine matching MITRE ATT&CK techniques (T1110, T1046)
architectureDetails: Client-side high-throughput parsing pipeline processing multi-thousand line server log files with instant regex heuristic detection and interactive chart visualization.

title: NetPulse Vulnerability Analyzer
summary: Automated Network Port & Service Vulnerability Assessment Scanner.
description: A python-powered network discovery tool that maps open ports, banner grabs active services, detects outdated protocol implementations, and correlates findings against common vulnerability databases.
highlights: Service banner grabbing for HTTP, SSH, FTP, and SMTP services
Risk rating based on port exposure and protocol security profile
Generates clear HTML/JSON network audit reports
keyFeatures: Customizable scan depth (Fast Scan vs. Full Deep Audit)
architectureDetails: Developed using Python socket programming and multi-threading for asynchronous TCP SYN/Connect probes with structured JSON payload generation.

title: Cyber Threat Intel Dashboard
summary: Centralized Threat Intelligence & Indicator of Compromise (IoC) Portal.
description: A clean web interface for managing Indicators of Compromise (IoCs) such as suspicious IP addresses, malicious domain names, file hashes (MD5, SHA256), and CVE advisories.
highlights: Unified repository for organizing and filtering threat IoCs
Searchable CVE database lookup with risk metrics
keyFeatures: IoC Search & Category Filtering (IP, Hash, Domain, URL)
Custom IoC entry and tagging system
architectureDetails: Fully client-side stateful threat intelligence engine built with React and local JSON persistent data structures.

title: CryptoShield Encryption Suite
description: An educational cryptographic studio demonstrating AES-256, RSA keypair generation, HMAC signature verification, and secure password hashing algorithms (SHA-256, bcrypt concepts).
highlights: Visual hash generation with collision resistance checks
Public/Private keypair simulator and signature validator
architectureDetails: Uses Web Crypto API standards for client-side cryptographic computations directly in the browser.
